help.title: ⚡️A fast bilibili downloader built with modern Python async features for bulk download of anime, TV shows, uploads, and more.
help.method:
get_series or s:   download whole series videos (including multi-part uploads, anime, series, movies, documentaries), or single videos
get_video or v:    download a specific video when you do not want other videos in the series
get_up or up:      download all uploads from a user, supports count limits, keyword search, and sorting
get_cate or cate:  download partition videos, supports count limits, keyword search, and sorting
get_favour or fav: download videos from favorites, supports count limits, keyword search
get_collect or col:download videos from a collection or playlist
info:              print detailed resource information (e.g. likes, quality, codec)
help.key:
For get_video/get_series, provide the video URL
For get_up, provide a Bilibili user page URL or user ID
For get_cate, provide a category name
For get_favour, provide a favorites page URL or favorites ID
For get_collect, provide a collection or playlist URL
For info, provide any resource URL
help.option.dir: Download directory. Defaults to ./videos and will be created if missing
help.option.log_dir: Directory to write audit logs. If relative it will be created under the download output path. Default: logs
help.option.quality: Video quality. Default 0 is highest, larger values are lower quality. Use strings like '1080p'
help.option.part_concurrency: Maximum segment concurrency per media. Default 10
help.option.cookie: Premium users may provide SESSDATA to download member-only videos
help.option.from_browser: Import cookies from a browser like safari, chrome, edge... default none
help.option.days: Results from the past number of days. Default 7. Only effective for get_up and get_cate
help.option.num: Number of uploads to download. Only effective for get_up, get_cate, get_favor
help.option.order: Sort order: pubdate (default), click, scores, stow, coin, dm. Only effective for get_up, get_cate
help.option.keyword: Search keyword. Only effective for get_up, get_cate, get_favor
help.option.no_series: Download only the first part of search results. Only effective for get_up, get_cate, get_favour
help.option.no_hierarchy: Do not use hierarchical directories; save all videos under the download directory
help.option.subtitle: Download SRT subtitles
help.option.only_audio: Download audio only, quality fixed to highest
help.option.p: Download episode range, e.g. -p 1 3 downloads P1 to P3. Only effective for get_series
help.option.codec: Video/audio codec (use info to inspect first). Use full names like avc1.640032 or fLaC, or partial names like avc, hev
help.option.speed_limit: Maximum download speed. Default unlimited. Example: -sl 1.5MB
help.option.stream_retry: Maximum retries for network errors during download. Default 5
help.option.time_range: Download time range format h:m:s-h:m:s or s-s. Default none. Only effective for get_video
help.option.language: Language setting, supports zh (default) and en
